name: Mirrors
long_description:
Production AI agents keep making the same mistakes. The usual fix is another line in the system prompt. Over time, the agent carries instructions for dozens of situations, even when it’s doing something simple, and every correction becomes another thing to maintain.

Mirrors lets developers maintain production agents by turning recurring mistakes into targeted corrections. It surfaces recurring mistakes across production runs. Developers write a correction, choose the situations where it applies, and preview its scope against past conversations. Once activated, Mirrors adds the correction to the agent only in those situations. Developers can then compare outcomes with and without the correction to see whether it helps. Unlike skills, the agent doesn’t decide what to load. The scope developers set does.

Corrections live in one place, scoped to the right accounts and workflows. Mirrors connects through an SDK and works with any agent framework. The application keeps control of its model calls and tools.
one_liner: Fix recurring AI agent mistakes with real-time guidance
